pages.text: The Blade Of A Thousand is - as the name implies - made from the blood of a thousand people. By extracting the iron from all that blood, a blunt iron blade of great size is created that can conjure a sharp aura of blood around it. Due to this nature, it's possible to also shoot out this blood as a slash by charging up an attack. This process

will consume a small amount of the blood and the blade will attempt to replenish this loss with the user's own blood. Additionally, the enchantments of Piercing, Power and Multishot will take effect on the projectile at least, but nor Flame nor Fire aspect will work. To assist with the creation of this sword, a Sacrificial Catalyst is needed, which requires several items such as: Coagulated Blood, Bloodweave, a Heart Transplant, an Organic Matter Block and a Concentration Core.

For the catalyst to absorb the blood of a person, it must be held in hand when killing said victim. Once enough sacrifices have been achieved, the catalyst will swiftly morph into a Blade Of A Thousand.

pages.title: Addendum
pages.text: Throughout my years of research pilgrimage, I ended up staying the night at numerous villages, far too many to count. And much of them were raided during my stay. I helped quite a bit with pushing back the pillagers thanks to my various equipments and that process only got easier once I got this blade. It wasn't intentionally created, it's simply another loot from a cultist that had joined the

raiders; which I ended up using myself. The catalyst had been plenty filled already when I got hold of it. At first, imagining how many villagers could have been sacrificed into it made me not even consider the idea of using it, even once I completed it out of curiosity through the raiders I've murdered. But then, on a certain night of protecting a village from a raid, there was a scene in front of me: a vindicator, axe in hand, was right about to strike down the villager that

allowed me to stay the night there. I had met their child earlier as well, they were very sweet. So in that moment sheer instinct took over me and I pulled it out of my backpack, with that same motion swinging it down hard enough to send a blood slash straight forward, cutting in half the vindicator. The villager survived thanks to my action and from then on I continued using it. All the raids I fought against afterwards had little to no innocent casualties.
